title: A lesson at the guild hall
built: Played: BALANCED_FAIR, seed 1, stopped on the morning of day 21.
description: Press End Day: the aftermath opens with "At the guild hall", a hero taught by a guildmate.

title: A fallen hero's blade passes to a guildmate
built: Played: BALANCED_FAIR, seed 12, stopped on the morning of day 11.
description: Press End Day: "A death", then "A blade passed on" to a living guildmate.

title: A merchant sells a fallen hero's blade
built: Played: BALANCED_FAIR, seed 87, stopped on the morning of day 9.
description: A travelling merchant holds a blade and a hero can pay for it. Press End Day: "Sold on by a merchant".

title: A champion falls at the wall
built: Played: BALANCED_FAIR, seed 11, stopped on the morning of day 15 (the siege day).
description: A siege day. Press End Day: "The siege" is lost as a rout, then "A death" at the wall. The forge survives.

title: Known Name: a regular on day 1
built: Played: era 1 on seed 2 (BALANCED_ACTIVE) to its end, claimed, Known Name bought with its points; era 2 on seed 5, three quick iron swords forged and listed on day 1.
description: Day 1 of era 2 with Known Name level 1: Town shows a regular already. Press End Day: the regular buys from the shelf.

title: A returned legend, asleep
built: Played: the Known Name account (era 1 on seed 2); era 2 on seed 33 (BALANCED_ACTIVE), stopped on the morning of day 5, the day after the blade returned.
description: Open Storage: a blade from the Legend Board has come back with its affixes dormant. Hone it and they wake. The blade is Starsteel Dagger.

title: One blade through three owners
built: Played: BALANCED_FAIR, seed 1, stopped on the morning of day 22.
description: Open Storage and the blade: its Story has three sales, its fights and a siege. The blade is Iron Bow.

title: A long storage: 200 blades
built: Constructed: BALANCED_FAIR, seed 1, morning of day 7; the materials and energy for 200 quick forges were added by hand, then each blade was forged by a real command.
description: Open Storage: about 200 unsold blades to filter, sort, select and salvage.

title: Visitor: the collector's offer
built: Constructed: a fresh run on seed 3, four quick blades forged on day 1, End Day; on day 2 one stored blade was given 3 fame and the collector was made this morning's visitor.
description: Shop: a visitor is at the forge. Sell the famous blade for good, or keep it for the town.

title: Visitor: the last crate, with an empty purse
built: Constructed: a fresh run on seed 3, four quick blades forged on day 1, End Day; on day 2 the forge's gold was set to 0 and the carter was made this morning's visitor (the siege is three days out).
description: Shop: a visitor is at the forge. Both purchases are closed with the reason shown; only the free answer can be committed.

title: Visitor: a blade for the wall
built: Constructed: a fresh run on seed 3, four quick blades forged on day 1, End Day; on day 2 one hero's purse was set to 5 gold, another's to 900, and the two were made this morning's visitors.
description: Shop: a visitor is at the forge. Arm the poor defender on trust (this starts the chain), take the rich patron's order, or neither.

title: Visitor: the master's afternoon
built: Constructed: a fresh run on seed 3, four quick blades forged on day 1, End Day; on day 2 the wandering master was made this morning's visitor.
description: Shop: a visitor is at the forge. Four energy for a journal entry, coin for a recipe clue, or keep working.

title: Visitor: a cracked family blade
built: Constructed: a fresh run on seed 3, four quick blades forged on day 1, End Day; on day 2 one hero was marked fallen on day 1 with a stored blade recorded as recovered from them, a living hero was put in the same guild, and they were made this morning's visitor.
description: Shop: a visitor is at the forge. Restore a fallen hero's blade for their guildmate, sell it to a collector, or keep it.

title: Visitor: the crooked merchant
built: Constructed: a fresh run on seed 3, four quick blades forged on day 1, End Day; on day 2 the merchant was made this morning's visitor.
description: Shop: a visitor is at the forge. Buy unseen, pay to look the blade over (the sheet stays open and shows it), or leave.

title: Visitor: the smith's wager
built: Constructed: a fresh run on seed 3, four quick blades forged on day 1, End Day; on day 2 the passing smith was made this morning's visitor.
description: Shop: a visitor is at the forge. Stake gold on forging the named blade in three days for a relic, take a plain order, or refuse.

title: Visitor: the festival contract
built: Constructed: a fresh run on seed 3, four quick blades forged on day 1, End Day; on day 2 the council was made this morning's visitor.
description: Shop: a visitor is at the forge. A stall brings the crowd today; arming the watch pays a bounty for two days.

title: Visitor: left unanswered
built: Constructed: a fresh run on seed 3, four quick blades forged on day 1, End Day; on day 2 the merchant was made this morning's visitor (seed 4).
description: Shop: a visitor is at the forge. Do not answer. The End Day button says what the visitor will be told; press it and Records shows that he left.

title: Relics: the opening draft
built: A fresh run on seed 3, nothing done.
description: Day 1: three relics are offered, one may be taken. Decide later and reopen it from Workshop relics in the Shop.

title: Relic: Salvager's Crucible
built: Constructed: a fresh run on seed 3, four quick blades forged on day 1, End Day; on day 2 the crucible was put in the workshop and two stored blades were raised to quality 55.
description: Open Storage and the fine blade: Salvage says it also returns the augment. Do it twice: the second gives the core only.

title: Relic: Tempering Ledger
built: Constructed: a fresh run on seed 3, four quick blades forged on day 1, End Day; on day 2 the ledger was put in the workshop with a streak of Sword and Axe.
description: Forge: a family outside the streak shows its quality bonus, one inside says it restarts the streak.

title: Relic: Collector's Seal
built: Constructed: a fresh run on seed 3, four quick blades forged on day 1, End Day; on day 2 the seal was put in the workshop with two seals, one stored blade was raised to power 80 and every blade was listed at its going rate.
description: Workshop relics shows two seals of three. A shelf sale of 100 gold or more in coin earns the third and a rare material.

title: Relic: Ashen Bellows
built: Constructed: a fresh run on seed 3, four quick blades forged on day 1, End Day; on day 2 the bellows were put in the workshop.
description: Forge: switch the bellows on for one blade. It gains a property; tomorrow starts 2 energy short, as End Day warns.

title: Relics: a fourth for a full workshop
built: Constructed: a fresh run on seed 3, four quick blades forged on day 1, End Day; on day 2 three relics were put in the workshop (two seals earned) and the bellows were offered.
description: Three relics are held and the fourth is offered: taking it means choosing which one to put away.

title: Siege trait: Long Assault
built: Played: BALANCED_ACTIVE, seed 1, stopped on the morning of day 8; the trait of the day 10 siege was set by hand.
description: Town shows the trait two days before the siege: worn blades count for less. Compare the outlook after giving blades to the watch.

title: Siege trait: Many Breaches
built: Played: BALANCED_ACTIVE, seed 1, stopped on the morning of day 8; the trait of the day 10 siege was set by hand.
description: Town shows the trait two days before the siege: the watch and militia count for more, the raid is stronger.

title: Chain: the debt repaid
built: Constructed: a fresh run on seed 3, four quick blades forged on day 1, End Day; on day 2 a hero's purse was set to 5 gold and their pledge taken by a real answer; the blade was forged (raised by hand to quality 70), the siege moved to that night and its raid cut to a tenth so the town held. This is the next morning.
description: The defender armed on trust came through the siege and is back at the forge: collect, forgive, or let it rest.

title: Chain: the defender did not live
built: Constructed: a fresh run on seed 3, four quick blades forged on day 1, End Day; on day 2 the pledge was taken and delivered by real commands as in the case above; then the hero was marked dead, the blade seized, and the day moved to the eve of the pledge falling due.
description: Press End Day: no visitor comes tomorrow. Records tells that the hero died and where the blade is.

title: Guild: day one, the first loan
built: Constructed: a guild run under Town's Last Hope on seed 3; the opening relic offer was declined and one quick iron sword forged, both by real commands.
description: Day 1 with a Guardian and a Warden signed and one sword in storage. Open the Guardian and loan them the sword: it leaves storage and shows in their hand; recall it and it is back. The blade is Flaming Iron Sword.

title: Guild: a party at a relic delve's checkpoint
built: Played: a guild run under Town's Last Hope, GREEDY_DIVER, seed 1, stopped on the morning of day 10; a blessing on offer was taken.
description: The party won the first stage of a relic delve and waits. The Guild screen asks: push on (the deeper stage, at its own risk) or return with what is secured. Choose, then press End Day.

title: Guild: the morning of a siege, one reserved
built: Played: a guild run under Town's Last Hope, SYNERGY, seed 1, stopped on the morning of day 5 (the siege day); a blessing on offer was taken and the Guardian reserved by a real command.
description: A siege comes tonight and the Guardian is kept for the wall. A contract on the board would take the others away: plan it and the wall's forecast names who is left; press End Day and the siege card says who stood.

title: Guild: a member held, a rescue posted
built: Played: a guild run under Town's Last Hope, GREEDY_DIVER, seed 1, stopped on the morning of day 18; a blessing on offer was taken.
description: A member is in enemy hands with a deadline, and the Rescue contract for them is on the board. Send a party: a won rescue brings them home, a missed deadline does not.

title: Guild: the charter siege, a strong roster
built: Constructed: a guild run under Town's Last Hope, SYNERGY, seed 4, played to the morning of day 20 (left as played, the wall is breached that night). Set by hand: every member at home raised to level 8 in full health with wounds cleared, every blade on loan to them raised to quality 90 and full repair. By real commands: a blessing on offer taken; the Guardian, the Warden and the Battlemage reserved for the wall.
description: The morning of day 20: the warlord leads tonight's siege. Press End Day: the wall holds, the charter is secured, and the run can go on or be closed with it.

title: Guild: Stormwell
built: Constructed: a guild run under Town's Last Hope on seed 3, day 1. By real commands: the relic offer declined, the offered Battlemage signed, the sword (Advanced, Iron, Stormglass, Binding Salt) and the staff (Iron, Verdant Sap) forged and loaned. Set by hand: 300 gold, the materials and energy for the two forges, the Overflow Basin in the workshop, and a Hunt generated onto the board a day early (drawn from a copy of the run's guild stream: the saved stream is not advanced).
description: The Guardian carries a Stormglass sword forged with Binding Salt, the Warden a staff, a Battlemage has signed, the Overflow Basin is held and a Hunt is on the board. Send the three on the Hunt and press End Day: the party's card tells the chain. The blade is Stormcharged Iron Sword.
